correctness.rationale: The vertex model consists of two poles and two staggered five-cycles: 12 vertices, degree five, 30 edges. The two-independent face condition (every induced connected component has at most two vertices) is equivalent to excluding connected induced triples. Independent reconstruction by breadth-first component counting over all 2^12=4096 masks gave exactly 324 faces including empty, with count by size [1,12,66,140,105], 105 and only 105 four-vertex maximal facets, and 80 forbidden connected triples. The fetched full explicit 105-mask shelling.json was independently checked against the exact facet set. For each of its 104 noninitial facets, enumerated all prior-intersection faces, confirmed that all maximal intersection faces have exactly three vertices (nonempty pure codimension-one intersection), and verified the unique minimal newly introduced restriction face. No failures; entire complex covered; 20 restriction faces equal their full tetrahedron. Standard pure shellability yields the integral homotopy type wedge_{20} S^3; h-vector [1,8,36,40,20] and reduced Euler characteristic -20 agree. This is an exhaustive finite certificate checked independently, not merely a log or a Betti calculation.
residual_risks: The shelling-to-sphere wedge implication uses a standard topological shellability theorem. No inference is claimed for all polyhedral graphs or other r.

value.rationale: The regular icosahedron is a canonical small, highly symmetric, 5-regular, nonchordal graph outside the standard block/tree shellability classes. Classifying its natural induced-component-at-most-two complex by a full shelling gives an integral wedge homotopy type and a reusable explicit finite certificate, rather than a routine Euler-characteristic or mod-two Betti computation. The exact dimension, facet count and sphere number are natural invariants researchers can use when testing stronger shellability criteria.
residual_risks: Single graph and r=2 only; sphere count alone was not substituted for shellability.

limitations: 105-facet pure shelling, not a general theorem for icosahedral variants
